benchmark.name: CoVerDynamicPerfBench_Compile
benchmark.comment: Runs multiple proxy apps to measure compile-time overhead

step.name: compile
step.do: ${MODULE_LOAD} if [[ "$proxy_app" == "lulesh" ]]; then time ${compiler_cxx} ${cover_analysis_arg} -DUSE_MPI=1 -g -O3 -o ${proxy_app}_${tool} LULESH/*.cc elif [[ "$proxy_app" == "lulesh_shmem" ]]; then time ${compiler_cxx} ${cover_analysis_arg} -DUSE_SHMEM=1 -g -O3 -o ${proxy_app}_${tool} LULESH-SHMEM/*.cc elif [[ "$proxy_app" == "stencil" ]]; then time ${compiler_c} ${cover_analysis_arg} -g -O3 -DRADIUS=1 -DSTAR=1 -DDOUBLE=1 -lm Stencil/stencil.c -o ${proxy_app}_${tool} elif [[ "$proxy_app" == "stencil_shmem" ]]; then time ${compiler_c} ${cover_analysis_arg} -g -O3 -DRADIUS=1 -DSTAR=1 -DDOUBLE=1 -lm Stencil/stencil_shmem.c -o ${proxy_app}_${tool} elif [[ "$proxy_app" == "tealeaf" ]]; then time ${compiler_cxx} ${cover_analysis_arg} -g -O3 -o ${proxy_app}_${tool} TeaLeaf/driver/*.cpp TeaLeaf/src/serial/*.cpp -I TeaLeaf/src/serial -I TeaLeaf/driver elif [[ "$proxy_app" == "tealeaf_shmem" ]]; then time ${compiler_cxx} ${cover_analysis_arg} -g -O3 -o ${proxy_app}_${tool} TeaLeaf-SHMEM/driver/*.cpp TeaLeaf-SHMEM/src/serial/*.cpp -I TeaLeaf-SHMEM/src/serial -I TeaLeaf-SHMEM/driver elif [[ "$proxy_app" == "miniweather" ]]; then time ${compiler_cxx} -g -O3 -D_NX=150 -D_NZ=75 -D_SIM_TIME=10000 -D_OUT_FREQ=1000 -D_DATA_SPEC=DATA_SPEC_THERMAL -lm miniWeather/miniWeather_mpi.cpp -o ${proxy_app}_${tool} elif [[ "$proxy_app" == "minimd" ]]; then time ${compiler_cxx} -g -O3 -lm miniMD/*.cpp -o ${proxy_app}_${tool} -DOMPFORSCHEDULE="" fi
